tasks.title: Implement qualified scheduler persistence, trusted catalog and coherent active revisions

Apply trusted catalog conflicts and guarded task preview/promotion using exact original Operations/Audit conventions and RM08 publication/release/assignment/owner-adoption. Prior active revision remains until coherent promotion/disable; shared changes visibly revalidate every affected task against current preconditions without overwriting edits. Definitions are passive; unsupported mapper/editor/identity/contract blocks activation. Preserve exact names/IDs and configuration ownership; no arbitrary executable handler creation. Check prior identity before new selection, compare immutable semantic digest, retain zero-run receipts and original selected run set across edits/pause/replay. Validate complete active task/mapping/resource/configuration capsules, deterministic trusted transformations including calendar-local-date, exact native source/target scope and all byte/fanout/quota/settlement reservations before commit. Commit every selected run, receipt and bounded existing outbox intent atomically or none; producer acceptance may redact unauthorized target identities/counts. Manual execution targets exactly one enabled authorized task, never shared trigger siblings. Serialize task disable/pending cancel with attempt admission; unknown never becomes noncommit or another-key work. tasks.title: Implement authoritative calendar evaluator and bounded replicated production
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Implement one pure BCL evaluator shared by authoritative preview and Management calendar production for FixedDelay/Daily/Weekly. Validate IANA zone, Skip invalid local times and OnceAtEarlierInstant repeats, explicit missed policies/defaults and bounded chronological catch-up. In one qualified transaction atomically arbitrate due instant/event/run set/progress across replicas, with canonical instant identity independent of revision. Active boundary changes supersede unadmitted old backlog honestly; unchanged pause/resume retains cursor. FixedDelay has exactly one designated TaskId/predecessor/successor, completion-relative timing, explicit immediate/Continue choices and default terminal pause; unresolved predecessor never advances and manual runs never advance it. Use existing sequential Management readiness/lifecycle with at most100 due records per yielding batch; no self-bootstrap cycle, per-trigger thread, unbounded ticks or poll history. Owns RM10-AC04, RM10-AC05, RM10-AC06, RM10-AC07, RM10-AC13, RM10-AC34.

tasks.title: Implement durable run/attempt history, report reconciliation and protected retention
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Persist/query the same durable logical runs and meaningful attempts for task/job/event views, with separate admission/entry/business-outcome/settlement and occurred/received observations, exact original operation and captured settings references. Authorize actual application/resource/run/attempt and every page/filter/detail; producer admission grants no target-history disclosure. Authenticate immutable sequenced reports: identical replay idempotent, conflicting same sequence refused, older progress cannot overwrite, late authorized original completion evidence may resolve unknown without reviving ownership. Retain actual immutable per-attempt release/build/handler and execution/recovery role; recovering build never steals original effect attribution. Coalesce ordinary progress5seconds, validate16KiB summaries/protected references, bound milestones/diagnostics and state growth. Use existing bounded cleanup/cached metrics-health owners: terminal details30days, aggregates180days, never prune unresolved/unsettled responsibility or needed compact receipts; quota reserves completion/recovery headroom and refuses new work. Owns RM10-AC16, RM10-AC17, RM10-AC22, RM10-AC23, RM10-AC24, RM10-AC25, RM10-AC30, RM10-AC34, RM10-AC36, RM10-AC38, RM10-AC40; this also supplies actual API and acceptance references for the approved history UI.
